context: 《Lost》劇中的潘妮與戴斯蒙，由莎妮亞·沃爾格（Sonya Walger）與亨利·伊恩·庫席克（Henry Ian Cusick）飾演，被封為電視史上最動人的戀人之一，甚至有粉絲為兩人刺了整條腿的紋身。搖滾樂團 Mastodon 貝斯手特洛伊·桑德斯（Troy Sanders）與鼓手布蘭恩·戴洛（Brann Dailor）也接受專訪，談新專輯如何向去年車禍過世的團員布蘭特·辛茲（Brent Hinds）致敬。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Sonya Walger and Henry Ian Cusick created a love so magical that they’re responsible for what’s widely regarded as the greatest TV episode of all time – not to mention inspiring a fan to get a full leg tattoo of their faces • More from our series Making Love: ‘We met and two minutes later we were kissing’ – how Gavin and Stacey became Britain’s most bang tidy TV couple Lost is one of television’s most romantic dramas. Forget smoke monsters, time travel and that infamous ending – this was a show fuelled by swoony stories. Sun and Jin; Rose and Bernard; Sawyer/Jack/Kate/Juliet; Charlie and Claire; Sayid and Nadia ( not Shannon). Love was the reason behind so many of the islanders’ need to survive, or to sacrifice themselves. But it was Penny’s and Desmond’s relationship that defined the series. Continue reading...

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The Grammy-winning band had an acrimonious rift with Hinds – then he died in a motorbike crash. They explain how they’re paying tribute on their new album, and why their love for each other never ended Mastodon are near the end of a tour where they’re playing 22 shows in 14 different European countries during a record-breaking heatwave, when they video-call me outside a Bordeaux venue. Bassist and co-lead singer Troy Sanders says the experience has been “31 days of musical bliss”. He’s not being sarcastic, either. “Things are super energetic, even at day 31,” he insists. “We’re contemplating even staying in Europe for a few days when this tour is over, because we’re enjoying ourselves so much.” It’s pleasantly surprising to see Sanders and drummer/co-vocalist Brann Dailor, sat to his left, in such high spirits, given the anguish and unrest they’ve endured over the last 18 months. Continue reading...

thread_text:
《Lost》經典戀人談初心

《Lost》劇中的潘妮與戴斯蒙，由莎妮亞·沃爾格（Sonya Walger）與亨利·伊恩·庫席克（Henry Ian Cusick）飾演，被封為電視史上最動人的戀人之一——甚至有粉絲為兩人刺了整條腿的紋身。兩人在專訪中回顧了這段感情戲的分量。

音樂這邊，搖滾樂團 Mastodon 的貝斯手特洛伊·桑德斯（Troy Sanders）與鼓手布蘭恩·戴洛（Brann Dailor）也接受了專訪，談新專輯如何向去年因車禍過世的團員布蘭特·辛茲（Brent Hinds）致敬。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 28 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
《Lost》經典戀人談初心

《Lost》劇中的潘妮與戴斯蒙，由莎妮亞·沃爾格（Sonya Walger）與亨利·伊恩·庫席克（Henry Ian Cusick）飾演，兩人接受專訪，回顧這段被封為電視史上最動人戀情之一的感情戲——甚至有粉絲因此刺了一整條腿的紋身，還有人用他們的名字幫小孩命名。

音樂這邊也有一則訪談。葛萊美得獎樂團 Mastodon 正在歐洲巡演，貝斯手特洛伊·桑德斯（Troy Sanders）與鼓手布蘭恩·戴洛（Brann Dailor）在專訪中談到，新專輯裡有向去年因摩托車車禍過世的團員布蘭特·辛茲（Brent Hinds）致敬的作品。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 28 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 《Lost》劇裡的潘妮與戴斯蒙，被封為電視史上最動人的戀人之一，兩位演員接受了專訪。這段感情戲有多深植人心？有粉絲為兩人刺了整條腿的紋身，還有人用他們的名字幫小孩命名。音樂這邊也有一則訪談。搖滾樂團 Mastodon 的兩位團員談到，新專輯裡有一首向去年車禍過世的團員致敬的作品。
